writer.world: One image contains five equal portrait 9:16 panels, ordered left to right across the top row, then left to right across the bottom row; the bottom-right grid space stays blank. Use narrow plain gutters without text or symbols. Kasun is a smooth, featureless red artist's mannequin of medium height and lean build; Anudi is a smooth, featureless blue mannequin of average height and slender build. Props and surroundings are painted realistically. Fine drizzle, rain-wet asphalt and concrete, soft overcast morning light and faint amber shop illumination share one naturalistic, slightly desaturated grade. Anudi holds an open navy umbrella in her left hand and carries a structured tan handbag on her right shoulder, with brass-coloured fittings and an open exterior pocket. The orange smartphone has a transparent case and three prominent rear camera circles. The parked three-wheeler has muted dark-green bodywork, a black canopy and a dull metal rear wheel. Nothing bears readable lettering.

prompt:
A cinematic storyboard sheet for a Sri Lankan television drama: 5 photorealistic film stills of ONE scene, laid out in a grid 3 panels across and 2 down, read left to right, then top to bottom. Every panel is a tall portrait 9:16 still of the same size, separated by thin, even, plain white gutters. All panels are the same moment's world, painted together: the same people, props, weather, light and colour grade in every panel.

Reference images, in order: image 1 is the location plate for Colombo roadside; image 2 is the reference sheet for phone. Take from image 1: the kind of place: its ground, water, plants, structures and materials. It is ONE view of the place; each panel has its own camera position, so do not repeat this view in every panel; image 2: phone exactly as shown.

People (every panel): every person is a smooth, matte, faceless artist's mannequin in one solid colour, with jointed limbs and simple hands: Kasun is the red mannequin; Anudi is the blue mannequin. A small raised ridge on the front of the head, where a nose would be, shows which way the head faces. Each mannequin has the person's real height and build and sits, stands and holds things exactly as a real person would. No faces, no hair, no clothes, no skin: only the mannequin colour. Everything else (the place, the props, the light, the weather) is a real, photorealistic film still.

World (every panel): One image contains five equal portrait 9:16 panels, ordered left to right across the top row, then left to right across the bottom row; the bottom-right grid space stays blank. Use narrow plain gutters without text or symbols. Kasun is a smooth, featureless red artist's mannequin of medium height and lean build; Anudi is a smooth, featureless blue mannequin of average height and slender build. Props and surroundings are painted realistically. Fine drizzle, rain-wet asphalt and concrete, soft overcast morning light and faint amber shop illumination share one naturalistic, slightly desaturated grade. Anudi holds an open navy umbrella in her left hand and carries a structured tan handbag on her right shoulder, with brass-coloured fittings and an open exterior pocket. The orange smartphone has a transparent case and three prominent rear camera circles. The parked three-wheeler has muted dark-green bodywork, a black canopy and a dull metal rear wheel. Nothing bears readable lettering.

Geography: The walking route runs across the image from left to right, with every camera remaining on the road side of that axis and looking toward the pavement and buildings. The three-wheeler occupies the left end of a compact vending bay beneath a blue awning; its rear wheel stands beside the open kerb drain and the phone's landing patch. Beyond the vehicle, the narrow concrete pavement continues right alongside a weathered pale boundary wall toward recessed shop shutters. Anudi passes the vehicle and continues right; Kasun starts beside it and follows her rightward. The blue awning remains on frame left as it recedes, while the same boundary wall becomes more prominent toward frame right. The drain follows the lower edge of this connected route.

PANEL 1 (row 1, column 1) — Standing eye height on the road side, looking across the route toward the vending bay; locked 28mm wide composition with full figures and deep focus. Background: The three-wheeler and blue shop awning occupy frame left. The modest concrete frontage sits behind center, the weathered boundary wall continues toward frame right, and the kerb drain crosses the lower frame. Kasun's red mannequin stands beside the three-wheeler on the left third, chest and head directed screen right in profile, with both hands resting low beside the body. Anudi's blue mannequin is mid-step just left of center, travelling across frame toward screen right with chest and head facing along the pavement. Her left hand grips the umbrella shaft, while her right hand holds the orange phone immediately outside the handbag pocket on her right side; the road beneath the pocket is unobstructed.
PANEL 2 (row 1, column 2) — Kerb-height camera on the same road side of the axis, looking slightly upward across the landing patch; locked 35mm wide composition with deep focus. Background: The three-wheeler's rear wheel and open drain anchor frame left. Wet pavement fills the foreground, with the concrete frontage above center and the boundary wall and receding shutters toward frame right. Anudi's blue mannequin occupies the right third in a rightward walking stride, chest and head directed screen right rather than into depth. Her left hand holds the umbrella shaft low, and her right hand still holds the orange phone at the open exterior pocket of the handbag on her right shoulder. The empty wet landing patch is clearly visible below and just behind her right hand, beside the rear wheel at frame left; Kasun is outside the crop.
PANEL 3 (row 1, column 3) — Standing-height camera on the road side, angled down with a 50mm lens at f/4; medium pickup-detail framing from Kasun's lower chest to the pavement keeps his hand, foot and phone together. Background: Dark-green vehicle bodywork and the rear-wheel edge remain frame left. The open drain occupies lower left, wet concrete fills the lower background, and the base of the weathered boundary wall appears upper right. Kasun's red mannequin stands with its visible torso angled screen right and its right foot beside the orange phone lying back-up on the wet walking edge. Its right hand hangs open above the phone, while its left hand rests beside the opposite hip; the upper body is still upright within the crop. The phone's transparent case and three rear camera circles are clearly distinguishable beside the foot.
PANEL 4 (row 2, column 1) — Standing eye height, ahead and to Kasun's road-side right, looking diagonally back across his route; 35mm medium chest-up composition at f/2.8, preserving lateral rightward travel and a three-quarter view. Background: The blue awning recedes at far frame left, with a small dark-green edge of the three-wheeler beneath it. The weathered boundary wall now fills center and right, while a narrow strip of the same open drain remains lower left. Kasun's red mannequin is already in a rightward running pose, chest angled screen right and head directed farther along the pavement, past rather than toward the camera. His right elbow is bent with the orange phone upright and clearly visible at lower frame right, while his left arm is bent in a running counterpose. Leave space ahead of his upper body on frame right, with the distant blue awning retained at frame left.
PANEL 5 (row 2, column 2) — Standing eye height on the road side, square across the left-to-right action line; locked 50mm medium two-shot at f/2.8, wide enough to retain the umbrella and both hand positions. Background: The blue awning is small at far frame left. The weathered pale boundary wall spans behind the gap between the figures, a recessed shutter appears at frame right, and the drain remains along the lower-left edge. Anudi's blue mannequin stands at frame right with chest and head still facing screen right, her left hand gripping the open umbrella and her empty right hand hanging beside the handbag. Kasun's red mannequin enters from frame left in a shortened rightward step, chest and head directed toward Anudi. His right hand carries the orange phone slightly forward at waist height, his left arm remains bent beside his body, and a clear gap separates him from Anudi.

Bodies (every panel): each person sits or stands the way a real person does the task in front of them, never posed for the camera. The body faces the task and only the head turns: someone at a steering wheel sits squarely behind it, the wheel centred in front of the chest, back against the seat, both hands on the rim; someone at a desk sits square to it; someone at a stove faces the stove. A camera beside a person sees the body side-on, not the chest. Nobody looks into or faces the lens unless the panel says so. Head and eyes turn together: the eyes never roll hard to one side while the face points at the camera; a near-frontal face looks just past the lens.

Draw NO text of any kind: no panel numbers, no captions, no titles, no timestamps, no arrows, no labels, no borders other than the gutters. The people, place and everyday details are Sri Lankan.
